name: principallatch-techjam
description: PrincipalLatch identity and revocable authorization middleware for the TikTok TechJam Bouncer track.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @principallatch/server" "npm run dev -w @principallatch/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @principallatch/core && npm run build -w @principallatch/web && npm run build -w @principallatch/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @principallatch/core && npm run build -w @principallatch/core && npm run typecheck -w @principallatch/server && npm run typecheck -w @principallatch/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @principallatch/core && npm run test -w @principallatch/core && npm run test -w @principallatch/server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:poc-launcher && npm run check:docs
scripts.verify:demo: npm run build -w @principallatch/core && npm run build -w @principallatch/server && node apps/server/dist/verify-demo.js
